goal: Decide the next realistic Master Data implementation route for customers, vendors and items/services: UI example, template, configuration package, Excel-assisted load or parked.
whyNow: Existing read-first evidence is useful for training and handbook preparation, but no Master Data write should happen until the implementation route is selected and bounded.
businessPurpose: Make the next Master Data step realistic for a customer project instead of treating UI clicks as the default setup method.
expectedOutput: A compact local result JSON comparing UI, Template, Configuration Package and Excel-assisted routes for customer, vendor and item/service setup.
A nextCase selection that is either a narrow read-first dependency proof or a local write-gate preparation.
Explicit boundaries for setup readiness, Master Data readiness, training and handbook use.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision requires opening Business Central or running Playwright live.
Stop if the output would create or edit Business Central data.
Stop if the output would make a final book or customer-handbook claim.
Stop if the route cannot be decided without new source or live evidence; select a read-first dependency case instead.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use if the route decision needs one fresh customer-page dependency proof before a write gate.
Use only if the route can be prepared without unresolved setup or source dependencies.
Use if Master Data routes remain blocked by Foundation setup dependencies.
